'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Shawn Banwell DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Shawn Banwell]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Informal sheet. Some shield-block lines look like main-deck interrupts kept as written where possible.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Shawn Banwell]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
